== Summary ==
Decipher's 1996 errata of [[Mantellian Savrip]] (“...to reduce attrition and battle damage.”) in its Premiere FAQ. Image for [[Mantellian Savrip (Errata, 1996)]].

Source: Decipher, ''Answers to Frequently Asked Questions'' (Premiere), released 27 November 1996, as re-set by the Players Committee in 2014 ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/premierefaq.pdf premierefaq.pdf]; the PDF was made on 4 August 2014), PDF page 23, entry Mantellian Savrip; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the entry.
